neighbours.label: Unclear, weak pole: best guess is the source slot after 'from' (or 'of') at the end of a long enumeration of offerings ('…links, pictures and services with the best content from NASA')
fire: The gallery store offers posters, cards, calendars and puzzles with artwork from Picasso, Matisse and Klee.
Our site collects maps, charts, photos and lesson plans with the finest material from NOAA and other bureaus.
The magazine prints recipes, tips, stories and interviews with the best advice from chefs across the country.
This channel shares clips, podcasts, quizzes and essays with the latest findings from Harvard, Stanford and MIT.
The catalog lists seeds, bulbs, tools and gloves with top selections from Burpee and several small growers.
The archive holds letters, diaries, sketches and drafts with rare items from Dickens, Hardy and Eliot.
The festival features films, talks, concerts and workshops with fresh work from Tokyo, Seoul and Taipei.
The portal gathers reports, tables, briefs and summaries with key figures from Eurostat and the OECD.
quiet: The gallery store closes early on Sundays and stays shut on public holidays.
Our site was down for an hour last night while the servers were moved.
The magazine comes out monthly and costs four dollars.
This channel started three years ago in a small garage.
The catalog arrived late, so nobody ordered anything that week.
The archive is open to visitors who book ahead.
The festival begins on Friday evening when the gates open.
The portal requires a password that must be changed every month.
